rationale: License, attribution, fork, and upstream security references must remain factually accurate.
Architecture and migration documentation may describe the upstream project historically.
Fork-routing guidance and release metadata must identify the approved upstream project accurately.
Compatibility fixtures and tests intentionally retain upstream-shaped sample data.
Agent guidance, inherited package attribution, and the disabled upstream workflow are compatibility or attribution metadata.
The URL is part of an inherited proprietary license notice and must not be rewritten.
Legacy intake-bot email recognition is a compatibility identifier, not a public support address.
Copyright and license notices identify the upstream rightsholder and license.
